summary: Felicia Stewart was the 2018 Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 46 and a resident of Mountain Brook. She earned a bachelor's degree in English from Spring Hill College and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. Her professional experience included medical-device sales, sales management, consulting for an LGBTQ-focused component fund at the Community Foundation of Greater Birmingham, nonprofit work, hospital involvement, education initiatives, and food-assistance efforts. Contemporary reporting identified her as openly gay and married to Christy.
